title: Pseudo-coherent derived evaluation isomorphism
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $K,L,M\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume that $K$ is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex], that $L$ is bounded below in the derived category, i.e. $L\in D^+(R)$, meaning $H^i(L)=0$ for all $i\ll0$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], and that $M$ has finite injective dimension (isomorphic to a bounded complex of injective $R$-modules) [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then the canonical derived evaluation morphism of [lem-trf-derived-evaluation-canonical-map]
$$R\operatorname{Hom}_R(L,M)\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}K\longrightarrow R\operatorname{Hom}_R(R\operatorname{Hom}_R(K,L),M)$$
is an isomorphism.
